title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #9

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which surah is number 110 in the Qur'an? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Ikhlas
   B. An-Nasr
   C. Al-Masad
   D. Al-Kafirun

2. What is the Prophet's way of life called? (1 mark)
   A. The Hajj
   B. The Zakat
   C. The Qibla
   D. The Sunnah

3. What did the Prophet (S.A.W.) do to solve the dispute about placing the Black Stone? (1 mark)
   A. Kept it for himself
   B. Asked one tribe alone to place it
   C. Threw it away
   D. Placed it on a cloak and let leaders lift it together

4. When eating with others from one dish, what should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Eat from your own side of the dish
   B. Push others
   C. Reach across for the best piece
   D. Take the whole dish

5. Which of these follows the Sunnah of eating? (1 mark)
   A. Criticise the food
   B. Eat while running
   C. Sit calmly, say Bismillah and eat with the right hand
   D. Use the left hand for pleasure

6. Which time is most important for a child to brush? (1 mark)
   A. Before going to bed
   B. Only after a visit to the dentist
   C. Only on Sunday
   D. Only after playing

7. Which three skills are named in the syllabus hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Driving, typing and singing
   B. Swimming, archery and horse riding
   C. Cooking, sewing and farming
   D. Reading, writing and drawing

8. Which name reminds us that Allah hears our dua? (1 mark)
   A. Ar-Rahman
   B. Al-Malik
   C. As-Sami'
   D. Al-Basir

9. What does the word "attribute" mean? (1 mark)
   A. A prayer
   B. A place
   C. A quality that describes someone
   D. A type of food

10. What is a good manner of making dua? (1 mark)
   A. Shout
   B. Never ask
   C. Begin with praise and end with Amin
   D. Ask only for toys

11. Neema tells the truth instead of lying at school. Which angels' duty helped her remember? (1 mark)
   A. Jibril
   B. Israfil
   C. Mikail
   D. Raqib and Atid

12. Belief in angels is one of the pillars of (1 mark)
   A. Islam only
   B. Zakat
   C. Iman
   D. Hajj

13. Which prophet is famous for patience during illness? (1 mark)
   A. Yusuf
   B. Dawud
   C. Ayyub
   D. Hud

14. Which example is a light najasa? (1 mark)
   A. Urine of a baby boy who feeds only on milk
   B. Urine of an adult
   C. Blood
   D. Dog saliva

15. What is a mihrab? (1 mark)
   A. The niche in a mosque showing the Qibla
   B. A prayer time
   C. A cap
   D. A type of clothes

16. How many rak'ahs does Dhuhr have? (1 mark)
   A. Three
   B. Four
   C. Two
   D. Five

17. Which is a condition of swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Taslim
   B. Prostrating
   C. Bowing
   D. Facing the Qibla

18. What is takbiratul ihram? (1 mark)
   A. Saying "Allahu Akbar" to begin the prayer
   B. Reciting Fatiha
   C. Saying salaam
   D. Bowing

19. What did the Prophet tell the man who prayed in a hurry? (1 mark)
   A. Continue
   B. Pray faster
   C. Go back and pray again
   D. Ignore it

20. What do we say when rising from ruku? (1 mark)
   A. Amin
   B. Bismillah
   C. Sami'allahu liman hamidah
   D. Alhamdulillah alone

21. Kindness to animals is (1 mark)
   A. An act of worship when done for Allah
   B. Only for farmers
   C. A waste
   D. Forbidden

22. In the Prophet's story, a woman was punished because she (1 mark)
   A. Fed a cat
   B. Gave a cat milk
   C. Adopted a cat
   D. Starved a cat she had tied up

23. In the Prophet's story, the man gave water to which animal? (1 mark)
   A. A goat
   B. A horse
   C. A cow
   D. A dog

24. What is a buibui? (1 mark)
   A. A cap
   B. A prayer
   C. A drink
   D. A black cover worn by women along the coast

25. Which is an evil of begging? (1 mark)
   A. Higher income
   B. Loss of dignity
   C. Better skills
   D. More friends

26. Why are parents to be respected? (1 mark)
   A. They are old only
   B. They are rich
   C. They are tall
   D. They sacrifice time, energy and money for us

27. Who is a "binamu"? (1 mark)
   A. Cousin
   B. Grandfather
   C. Aunt
   D. Uncle

28. What was he called before prophethood? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Amin
   B. Al-Farooq
   C. Al-Haqq
   D. As-Siddiq

29. What does the Qur'an (9:40) mention about the Prophet and Abu Bakr? (1 mark)
   A. They were traders
   B. They were together in the cave
   C. They were in Habasha
   D. They were at Taif

30. What was Khadija's job? (1 mark)
   A. Farmer
   B. Soldier
   C. Teacher
   D. Businesswoman

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Explain the message of the last verse of Surah Al-Kafirun. (3 marks)

32. State two ways to know the times of prayer. (2 marks)

33. Explain how physical fitness helps a Muslim in worship and in daily life. (4 marks)

34. Explain how Ibrahim and Ismail (A.S.) showed obedience to Allah. (4 marks)

35. Explain why keeping family ties is important. (4 marks)

36. Write a dua using two of Allah's names and explain why you chose them. (4 marks)

37. Give one example of each type of najasa. (3 marks)

38. Draw or describe a simple family chart showing at least five relatives and their Kiswahili names. (5 marks)

39. State three times when the siwak or toothbrush is recommended. (3 marks)

40. Describe how to clean a medium najasa on a mat. (3 marks)

41. Choose any two prophets and explain one virtue from the life of each. (5 marks)

42. Write any ten prophets mentioned in the Qur'an. (5 marks)

43. Give three effects of belief in angels on a Muslim's life. (3 marks)

44. State two lessons a child can learn from the Prophet's youth. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #9 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — An-Nasr
   An-Nasr is 110, Al-Masad 111 and Al-Kafirun 109.

2. D — The Sunnah
   Sunnah means the way of the Prophet.

3. D — Placed it on a cloak and let leaders lift it together
   The cloak let every tribe share in the honour.

4. A — Eat from your own side of the dish
   The hadith teaches eating from what is in front of you.

5. C — Sit calmly, say Bismillah and eat with the right hand
   These are Sunnah manners.

6. A — Before going to bed
   Less saliva flows during sleep.

7. B — Swimming, archery and horse riding
   The hadith says to teach children these skills.

8. C — As-Sami'
   As-Sami' hears whispers and silent prayers.

9. C — A quality that describes someone
   An attribute is a quality, like kindness.

10. C — Begin with praise and end with Amin
   Dua begins with praise.

11. D — Raqib and Atid
   They record what we say.

12. C — Iman
   The six pillars of Iman include angels.

13. C — Ayyub
   Ayyub was tested with illness and stayed patient.

14. A — Urine of a baby boy who feeds only on milk
   Light najasa is cleaned by sprinkling.

15. A — The niche in a mosque showing the Qibla
   It marks the direction of prayer.

16. B — Four
   Dhuhr has four.

17. D — Facing the Qibla
   Facing Qibla is a condition; bowing is a pillar.

18. A — Saying "Allahu Akbar" to begin the prayer
   It starts the prayer.

19. C — Go back and pray again
   He did not pray properly.

20. C — Sami'allahu liman hamidah
   Allah hears the one who praises Him.

21. A — An act of worship when done for Allah
   Mercy pleases Allah.

22. D — Starved a cat she had tied up
   She did not feed it or let it find food.

23. D — A dog
   Allah forgave him for it.

24. D — A black cover worn by women along the coast
   A buibui is a cover.

25. B — Loss of dignity
   Begging lowers dignity.

26. D — They sacrifice time, energy and money for us
   Gratitude.

27. A — Cousin
   Binamu means cousin.

28. A — Al-Amin
   Al-Amin means the trustworthy.

29. B — They were together in the cave
   The Qur'an mentions the two in the cave.

30. D — Businesswoman
   She was a respected trader.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: "For you is your religion and for me is mine." A Muslim stays firm in his faith and respects the right of others to hold their beliefs.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning, 1 mark for firmness, 1 mark for respect.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: Adhan, printed mosque timetable, prayer app, watching the sun.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

33. (4 marks)
   Answer: It makes prayer postures, fasting and walking to the mosque easier. It also gives strength for work and helping others.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for worship points and 2 marks for daily life points.

34. (4 marks)
   Answer: Ibrahim was told in a dream to sacrifice his son, Ismail said to do as commanded and that he would be patient, and both were ready. Allah replaced Ismail with a ram.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the command, 1 mark for Ismail's reply, 1 mark for readiness, 1 mark for the ram.

35. (4 marks)
   Answer: It is Allah's command, it brings love, unity and support, brings blessing and is an act of worship.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

36. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: "Ya Rahman, Ya Rahim, forgive me and have mercy on me", because I need mercy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct name, 1 mark for the request, 1 mark for the reason.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: Light: urine of a baby boy on milk only; medium: urine, stool, blood or vomit; heavy: dog or pig saliva.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each example.

38. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example: babu, bibi, baba, shangazi, mjomba, binamu, each placed correctly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct relative up to 5.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: Before wudhu and prayer, on waking up, when the mouth smells, before sleeping.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct time.

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: Remove the substance, pour water until the colour, smell and taste have gone, then dry.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for removal, 1 mark for washing until traces go, 1 mark for drying.

41. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example: Ayyub showed patience in illness; Ibrahim showed generosity to guests.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each prophet, 1 mark for each virtue, 1 mark for a clear explanation.

42. (5 marks)
   Answer: Any ten of Adam, Idris, Nuh, Hud, Salih, Ibrahim, Lut, Ismail, Ishaq, Yaqub, Yusuf, Ayyub, Shuayb, Musa, Harun, Dhul-Kifl, Dawud, Sulaiman, Ilyas, Al-Yasa, Yunus, Zakariyya, Yahya, Isa, Muhammad.
   Working / marking points: Half a mark for each name up to 5 marks.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: More honesty, more thankfulness, respect for the Qur'an, remembering death and the Day of Judgement.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid effect.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: Honest work is honourable, and a person can be good even if poor or an orphan.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each lesson.
